original.statement: The frontend.cache-split-interval CLI flag is removed; results caching interval is now determined by querier.split-queries-by-interval.

consequence.statement: Environments that set the frontend.cache-split-interval CLI flag stop having that value honoured; the results caching interval is determined by querier.split-queries-by-interval instead.
consequence.remediation: Remove the frontend.cache-split-interval flag and configure querier.split-queries-by-interval to get the desired results caching interval.

corrected.statement: In Loki 3.0.0 the frontend.cache-split-interval CLI flag is removed; a value set on it is no longer honoured, and the results caching interval is now determined by querier.split-queries-by-interval.

decision.reason: [ev-f5a61f629314] says the `frontend.cache-split-interval` CLI flag is removed and that the results caching interval is now set by `querier.split-queries-by-interval`, another Loki flag. A value set on the removed flag is no longer honoured, which is setting-ignored. superseded-upstream does not fit, because the replacement is another setting in the same product, not an upstream mechanism. The section context lists the same pattern for other removed keys ([ev-03b4fbe630df], [ev-dc20110f4f4b]), and nothing says the replacement takes over the old value automatically.
